parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Free-Mobile destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-freemobile` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `freemobile://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two Apprise channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters. Two transformer channels skip Apprise entirely and transform the envelope directly into a Free-Mobile SMS API JSON body posted to smsapi.free-mobile.fr: the free `gateway` channel delivers direct to your Free-Mobile SMS API, and the `gateway-plus` channel adds extra per-enrollment Free-Mobile destinations at $0.001 per message.
parameters.gateway_body_template: {"user":"${ customer_secrets.FREEMOBILE_USER }","pass":"${ customer_secrets.FREEMOBILE_PASSWORD }","msg":{* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="" and ": " or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Free-Mobile destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Free-Mobile SMS API (no Apprise)

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Free-Mobile password

user_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Free-Mobile user
